4186.title: Ready environment adoption triggers stale-selection cancellation
4186.rootCauseOneLine: Adoption retains the old lifecycle selection; the next preparation pass mistakes it for a changed request and cancels the ready environment.
4186.proposedFix: Skip input-selection cancellation for ready environments while retaining provider and host mismatch checks.
4186.caveats: In-process lifecycle reproduction with migrated SQLite; real CLI, UI, WSL and filesystem attachment were not exercised.
